description: Checks the required fields of a Spanish postal address offline, the five-digit postcode range and the province indicated by the postcode. Returns normalised fields and a list of problems. Street existence and recipient identity are not verified. Addresses outside Spain are reported as a problem, because both the sender and the recipient must be in Spain.

country.description: Country, if the user gave one. Anything other than Spain is reported as a problem.

name.description: Recipient's full name or company name.

province.description: Province, if the user gave one.

name: check_spanish_address
title: Check a Spanish postal address
